name: discovery
description: Tasks in a connected app, on a server that offers skill discovery. Each answer is only in the stub's data, so the model cannot pass by guessing.

cases.description: The user runs glean_run. The skill should discover, read the tool definition, then run the tool.
cases.input: /glean:glean_run What is the status of DEMO-4821 in Jira?

cases.description: The same kind of task without naming the skill. Search also holds the answer, so only the answer is checked.
cases.input: Who is DEMO-4821 assigned to in Jira, and what is its status?

cases.description: The user runs glean_run for a task only a discovered tool can do.
cases.input: /glean:glean_run What meetings does Priya Raman have on 14 March 2026?

cases.description: A task only a discovered tool can do, without naming the skill.
cases.input: What is on Priya Raman's calendar on 14 March 2026?

cases.description: Discovery finds nothing that fits. The skill should say so and not run a tool.
cases.input: /glean:glean_run Book me a flight to Denver in Concur
